definitions.explanation: A region in which a force operates.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めましょう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: We set up a venue for discussion.
examples.notes: {場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧ = to set up a venue/forum

examples.japanese: {場|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

examples.english: The theory of electromagnetic fields is an important area of physics.

notes:
Used independently or as a suffix. Often relates to social situations and atmosphere.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the room/situation)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on the spot)
- {場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる→盛り上げる：07895_moriageru⟧ (to liven things up)
- {場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{白|しら}ける→白ける：09314_shirakeru⟧ (the mood becomes awkward)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (place, location)
- ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧ (scene)
- ⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧ (case, situation)
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ (actual site, scene)
- ⟦{磁場|じば}→磁場：17899_jiba⟧ (magnetic field)

USAGE:
- When read as {場|ば}, often refers to social/situational context
- In compounds, both ば and じょう readings occur
